title: Parse and install reached BMS and CSD resources
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of resource_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: PR #179 / #219 derived-evidence refresh: BMS model JUSTIFY and map-origin debug fields (da74f19, 5b4600a); removing these added fields exactly reproduces the historical digest. Historical command rows remain historical; the unchanged current gate verifies the refreshed receipt.
The generic application kernel parses DFHMSD/DFHMDI/DFHMDF continuations, anonymous and named fields, positions, lengths, attribute lists, initial text, macro options, and final markers.
Generic CSD DEFINE parsing retains resource kind/name and owned parenthesized properties without path or application-specific branches.
All 21 BMS sources produce 21 mapsets/maps and 1,164 fields; four CSD inputs merge into 25 transactions, 26 programs, eight files, and one TDQUEUE.

All 25 transaction-to-program references validate against CSD definitions and source availability except the explicit pinned CDV1->COCRDSEC orphan; it is retained as unresolved rather than silently synthesized.
The length-delimited resource digest covers source-relative BMS models and every canonical CSD resource/property map.
